equivalent_pairs.denominator: complete base/de_morgan pairs; invalid/error answers never agree

billing.note: Provider-reported subtotal for saved attempts only. Missing amounts and requests without a saved response are not included; missing does not mean free.

note: Accuracy reflects the latest attempt per row; invalid/error states count as incorrect. Error-state and in-flight rows stay pending for resume. Observations share scenes and equivalent pairs; they are not independent.
